task_intent.title: 001-split-llm-ts-into-domain-specific-service-modules
task_intent.description: The file src/services/llm.ts has grown to 434 lines and handles multiple unrelated concerns: chat completions (design, agent, search, thinking), image generation, prompt enhancement, image editing/analysis, and agent workflow orchestration. This violates single responsibility and makes the file difficult to navigate.
